recovery_publication.scope: Process exits before named real I/O operations; no Rust destructors run. Includes retry and independent DuckDB reads. Does not simulate power loss or arbitrary filesystem behavior.

records.sql: CREATE TABLE t(i INTEGER, s VARCHAR); INSERT INTO t VALUES(1,'one'),(2,'two'),(2,'duplicate'),(NULL,'null'); CREATE TABLE u(i INTEGER); INSERT INTO u VALUES(2),(3),(NULL);
SELECT (SELECT 7), (SELECT i FROM t WHERE false), (SELECT (SELECT 9))
SELECT NULL IN(SELECT i FROM t WHERE false), NULL NOT IN(SELECT i FROM t WHERE false), EXISTS(SELECT i FROM t WHERE false), NOT EXISTS(SELECT i FROM t WHERE false)
SELECT i, i IN(SELECT i FROM u), i NOT IN(SELECT i FROM u), EXISTS(SELECT * FROM u WHERE u.i=t.i), NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM u WHERE u.i=t.i) FROM t
SELECT i,(SELECT count(*) FROM t b WHERE b.i=a.i),(SELECT max(b.i) FROM t b WHERE b.i<a.i) FROM t a
SELECT i,(SELECT (SELECT a.i)) FROM t a
SELECT i,(WITH c AS(SELECT a.i x) SELECT (SELECT max(x) FROM c)) FROM t a
SELECT i,(SELECT max(i) FROM (SELECT 42 i) t) FROM t
SELECT i,(SELECT t.i),count(*) FROM t GROUP BY i HAVING (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE u.i=t.i)>0
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT CAST('bad' AS INTEGER)), EXISTS(SELECT sum(CAST('bad' AS INTEGER)) FROM t), EXISTS(SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE false)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT DISTINCT i FROM t OFFSET 2), EXISTS(SELECT DISTINCT i FROM t OFFSET 3), EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t LIMIT 0), EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t OFFSET 4)
SELECT CASE WHEN false THEN (SELECT i FROM t) ELSE 7 END
SELECT coalesce(5,(SELECT i FROM t))
SELECT (SELECT i FROM t ORDER BY i DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
SELECT (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1)
SELECT 2 IN(SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2), 3 NOT IN(SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2)
SELECT a.i ai,b.i bi FROM t a LEFT JOIN u b ON b.i=(SELECT max(c.i) FROM t c WHERE c.i=a.i)
SELECT i,(SELECT 3) FROM t ORDER BY (SELECT t.i) DESC
SELECT sum((SELECT t.i)) FROM t
WITH C AS(SELECT 8 i,'cte' s) SELECT i,s FROM t WHERE i=(SELECT min(i) FROM t) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM C
SELECT (SELECT i FROM t)
SELECT TRY_CAST((SELECT i FROM t) AS INTEGER)
SELECT (SELECT i,s FROM t)
SELECT 1 IN(SELECT i,s FROM t)
SELECT (SELECT i),count(*) FROM t
SELECT (SELECT i FROM u a,u b)
SELECT (SELECT missing FROM t)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE CAST('bad' AS INTEGER)=i)

CREATE TABLE target(i INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, v INTEGER); INSERT INTO target VALUES(1,10),(2,20),(3,30); UPDATE target SET v=(SELECT max(v) FROM target b)+i WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE t.i=target.i)
SELECT * FROM target
DELETE FROM target WHERE i NOT IN(SELECT i FROM t WHERE i IS NOT NULL); INSERT INTO target SELECT 4,(SELECT sum(v) FROM target)
SELECT * FROM target
UPDATE target SET v=(SELECT i FROM t)
SELECT * FROM target
CREATE TABLE copied AS SELECT i,(SELECT v FROM target b WHERE b.i=a.i) v FROM target a
SELECT * FROM copied
